tweet.text:
BREAKING: 🇺🇸 Democrats face a push for a “day 1” ban on AI superintelligence, with up to 20 YEARS in prison for violators.

Arizona Rep. Yassamin Ansari says a pause on advanced AI and a ban on artificial superintelligence must be “top of the Democratic agenda on day 1.”

A bill that would do exactly that was introduced by Bernie Sanders and Greg Casar in September.

Under the bill:

- Developing or deploying superintelligent AI would be banned

- Advanced AI development would pause until a new federal regulator sets rules and a model review process

- A new cabinet-level AI department would monitor frontier models and oversee removing dangerous capabilities, like ignoring shutdown commands

- Companies that try to get around it would face the “corporate death penalty”

- Individuals would face up to 20 years in prison

AI and data centers were a “crucial or major factor” for 56% of voters in the midterms, per an NBC News exit poll.
